data.title: Over 14,800 Islamic Guidance Programs Carried Out Across Makkah in Q3 2026
data.content:
Makkah, October 16, 2026, SPA -- The Ministry of Islamic Affairs, Dawah and Guidance carried out 14,856 outreach and awareness activities during the third quarter of 2026 across Makkah Region.
    The initiative aligns with the ministry's mission to disseminate religious knowledge grounded in the principles of moderation and balance. By delivering diverse programs tailored to all segments of society, the ministry aims to promote a sound understanding of Islamic concepts, fostering an informed community committed to its faith and national values.
    -- SPA
